summary: Revision 1 (PR #88, superseded) corrected the two legacy Fate Line break/fragmentation defects that PP-RELAY-048's revision-3 preflight flagged as outside its own scope, in src/content/blog/beginner/fate-line.md's 'Breaks and interruptions' section (with its FAQ and 'Common myths' echoes) and src/content/blog/beginner/no-fate-line-meaning.md's 'Broken or fragmented fate line' paragraph. Director review found one residual defect in revision 1's own new prose: fate-line.md's 'Common myths' entry stated Cheiro's verified break reading was 'not with failure or ruin, and not with any fixed outcome' and that the overlapping-break reading was 'not a verdict on the life as a whole' -- negative claims about what Cheiro's reading excluded that the controlling evidence (.ai-ops/evidence/PP-RELAY-048-cheiro-fate-line-break.md) does not establish. Revision 2 preserves the sound revision-1 diff in full and corrects only that sentence: it now states the accurate Cheiro association (career troubles and lack of settled or continuous success; for an overlapping break, a complete change in surroundings and position) followed by a separately labeled Palmistry Path editorial-policy statement that the site does not use either reading to predict or guarantee a fixed outcome, matching the same article's already-correct FAQ wording. Updated docs/CHANGELOG.md and docs/source-verification-log.md (Pass 16, revision 2) with the corrected claim-level evidence map and full SOURCE_SENSITIVE preflight disposition, including a targeted search confirming no unsupported negative historical claim about Cheiro's break reading remains in the changed files.
